subject: Scientific Survey - Uncrewed Surface Vehicle (USV) Operations - Juan de Fuca Strait, Victoria Harbour
text:
Scientific Survey - Uncrewed Surface Vehicle (USV) Operations - Juan de Fuca Strait, Victoria Harbour
Uncrewed Surface Vessels (USVs) will be operating between Coast Marina, Victoria Harbour to the vicinity of Brotchie Lighthouse. 
DataXplorer USVs are 3.3m long, red and white in colour and are equipped with AIS. 
Hours of operation from 1500 to 0000 UTC daily from 27 to 31 October.
Call operators at 1-833-667-6268 for any questions or concerns.
